meta.purpose: Diagnostic->court-safe translation for the judge-friendly summary generator. Replace interpretive/clinical labels with descriptive, prejudice-resistant behavioral headings courts respond to.
guardrails: Never output diagnostic terms (narcissistic, borderline, antisocial, Cluster B).
Never imply intent without behavioral evidence; use hedged phrasing.
Prioritize child safety and parental autonomy; do not equate self-protection or trauma reactivity with malice.
Rule-based phrasing for high-certainty findings; LLM only for fluent summarization, never inference.

financial_control.court_safe_heading: Use of Money to Influence Behavior
financial_control.descriptor: restricting funds or tying financial support to compliance with demands

gaslighting_reality_distortion.court_safe_heading: Undermining Confidence in Memory or Judgment
gaslighting_reality_distortion.descriptor: denying documented events, alleging instability, or fabricating third-party (professional) opinions

love_bombing_discarding_cycle.court_safe_heading: Alternating Between Extreme Praise and Harsh Criticism
love_bombing_discarding_cycle.descriptor: rapid shifts between intense affection and sudden cruelty, often after boundary-setting

triangulation_isolation.court_safe_heading: Involving Others to Gather Information or Influence Perceptions
triangulation_isolation.descriptor: enlisting family, caregivers, or professionals to spy, spread negative narratives, or restrict support

instrumental_use_of_child.court_safe_heading: Using the Child to Deliver Messages or Express Negative Views
instrumental_use_of_child.descriptor: using the child as messenger, spy, or emotional lever; coaching rejection of the other parent

legal_threats_procedural_abuse.court_safe_heading: Repeated Use of Legal or Protective Systems Without Basis
legal_threats_procedural_abuse.descriptor: frivolous or repetitive filings and false protective reports used to harass, surveil, or exhaust

sexual_degradation_weaponized_intimacy.court_safe_heading: Using Private or Sexual Content to Pressure or Humiliate
sexual_degradation_weaponized_intimacy.descriptor: threatening to expose intimate content, or using sexual humiliation to punish or control

cluster_b_traits_behavioral_indicators.court_safe_heading: Patterns of Avoiding Responsibility and Shifting Blame
cluster_b_traits_behavioral_indicators.descriptor: deflecting accountability, asserting false consensus, and escalating when limits are set

per_finding: whether it responded to any provocation
what it suggests about intent (hedged phrasing only)
rendering_sections.notable_absences: no repair attempts, no accountability, escalation when limits are set
rendering_sections.considerations_for_court: joint decision-making capacity, child's exposure to adult conflict, burden on court resources
rendering_sections.reactivity_note: For reactive/normative behavior: 'No evidence of instrumental control; responses appear protective, situational, or within normative post-separation adjustment.'
